theorems.name: Submission.ball_weakly_harmonic_local_representative
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ w : Rn n → ℝ, IntegrableOn w (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball 0 1 → ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, w x * Laplacian.laplacian ζ x = 0) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → ∃ v : Rn n → ℝ, InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd v (ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - ε)) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - 2 * ε))), v x = w x
